title: One job, at most two attempts: a hand-authored retry model

provenance.description: Original teaching example, not extracted from worker.mjs or an observed execution.

assumptions: Exactly one job and one active attempt; events are processed one at a time.
A failure of attempt 1 permits exactly one retry; a failure of attempt 2 exhausts the budget.
An active attempt receives either success or failure, not both.
omissions: No wall clock, overlapping requests, transport cleanup, cancellation, backoff or external side effects.
Exactly-once delivery and actual implementation behavior are not established.

states.description: First attempt failed; one retry remains.
Second and final attempt is active.
An attempt succeeded; this model permits no more events.
Second attempt failed; this model permits no more events.
A forbidden third attempt; intentionally unreachable in this model.

transitions.basis: Teaching rule: only a queued job can start its first attempt.
Teaching rule: success terminates the job.
Teaching rule: the first failure leaves one retry.
Teaching rule: consume the single retry.
Teaching rule: retry success terminates the job.
Teaching rule: two failures exhaust the budget.

rules.description: A third attempt must not be reachable.
